transform.title: Transform
transform.question: Which directions matter?
transform.blurb: Re-express the data in a basis where energy is concentrated and samples are decorrelated. Compresses nothing by itself: 64 pixels in, 64 coefficients out. It sets up the Butcher and the Packer to win.

predict.title: Prediction / modeling
predict.question: Can I guess the next thing from what I already have?
predict.blurb: Predict each sample from the past, then only code the residual (the surprise). Also known as the "modeling" half of modeling + coding. Dictionary matchers like LZ77 live here too: a match is a prediction that came true.

quantize.title: Quantization
quantize.question: How do I turn numbers into a few bits?
quantize.blurb: The only stage that throws information away. Rounds continuous values onto a grid or a codebook. Every lossy codec has exactly one of these; every lossless codec has none. Controls the rate-distortion trade-off.

entropy.title: Entropy coding
entropy.question: Some symbols are common. Can I give them shorter codes?
entropy.blurb: Lossless. Turns a stream of symbols with a known (or adaptive) probability model into close to H bits per symbol, the Shannon bound. This is the only stage that produces actual bits. If upstream stages did their job, the symbols here are skewed and cheap.

perceptual.title: Perceptual model
perceptual.question: What will the human never notice?
perceptual.blurb: Decides where the Butcher is allowed to be brutal. A psychoacoustic model, a contrast-sensitivity curve, a trained discriminator. Not a stage that data flows through, more a stage that steers the quantizer.

prior.title: Shared prior / side information
prior.question: What does the decoder already know before the first byte arrives?
prior.blurb: Anything shipped to the decoder ahead of time and not counted in the bitstream: standard tables, a trained dictionary, a VQ codebook, a neural decoder. The more the two sides pre-agree on, the fewer bits travel. The cost: versioning, size, and a decoder that only understands one kind of data.

codecs.name: DEFLATE / zip / gzip
codecs.notes: LZ77 32 KB window + two Huffman trees per block. Self-describing: trees travel in the header.

codecs.name: zstd
codecs.notes: LZ77 with a large window + FSE (tANS) for match lengths/offsets, Huffman for literals. Optional trained dictionary.

codecs.name: PNG
codecs.notes: Per-row Paeth-family filters, then DEFLATE. Invented to dodge the LZW patent.

codecs.name: bzip2
codecs.notes: Burrows-Wheeler block sort + move-to-front + RLE + Huffman. A transform in a lossless codec.

codecs.name: PAQ / cmix
codecs.notes: Context mixing with a neural mixer feeding a binary arithmetic coder. The ratio ceiling, at KB/s speeds.

codecs.name: JPEG
codecs.notes: YCbCr 4:2:0, 8×8 DCT, quant tables, zigzag run/size Huffman.

codecs.name: JPEG 2000
codecs.notes: Wavelets + EBCOT bit-plane arithmetic coding. 20% better than JPEG, far more complex; lives in cinema and medical imaging.

codecs.name: WebP (lossy)
codecs.notes: VP8 intra frame: directional block prediction, 4×4 DCT, boolean arithmetic coder. WebP lossless is a different squad: Neighbor + LZ77 + Huffman with color cache.

codecs.name: FLAC
codecs.notes: Mid/side + LPC order ≤32 + Rice. Integer-only decoder.

codecs.name: MP3
codecs.notes: Hybrid filterbank + MDCT, psychoacoustic model, power-law quantizer, 32 standard Huffman tables.

codecs.name: Opus
codecs.notes: SILK (LPC, speech) + CELT (MDCT with 2.5-20 ms frames, algebraic PVQ defined in the spec) + range coder. The best non-neural low-latency codec; 6-510 kbps.

codecs.name: SoundStream / EnCodec
codecs.notes: Causal conv encoder, residual VQ, conv decoder, adversarial training. Fixed-rate tokens; no entropy coder by default.

codecs.name: H.264 / AVC
codecs.notes: The hybrid video codec template: inter + intra prediction, integer DCT, RDO-driven quantizer, CABAC.

codecs.name: Faiss IVF-OPQ-PQ
codecs.notes: OPQ rotation, 8-bit product codes, codebooks in the index, fixed-length codes for ADC scanning.

codecs.name: GGUF Q4_K_M
codecs.notes: Block-wise 4-bit with 6-bit scales. Dequantize inside the matmul kernel. No entropy coding.

codecs.name: safetensors
codecs.notes: No compression at all: JSON header + raw tensor bytes. Optimizes for mmap, zero-copy and safe loading. An empty squad is a legitimate design.

codecs.name: KIVI / QuaRot (KV cache)
codecs.notes: Per-channel keys, per-token values, group 32, newest 128 tokens in fp16; optional Hadamard rotation to tame outlier channels. Online, inside the forward pass.

codecs.name: KVQuant
codecs.notes: Pre-RoPE keys, per-layer non-uniform levels from calibration, 1% outliers in a sparse fp16 list, sink token at full precision. 1M tokens of LLaMA-7B on one A100.

codecs.name: Coupled Quantization / CommVQ
codecs.notes: VQ over 4-8 channels with Fisher-weighted centroids (CQ), or additive RoPE-commuting codebooks (CommVQ). 1-2 bits per element, fixed-length, no Packer.

codecs.name: HiSparse (SGLang)
codecs.notes: DSA indexer on the GPU, full KV in host DRAM, per-layer LRU buffer, one fused gather kernel. The address book stays dense; the latents travel.

codecs.name: ShadowKV
codecs.notes: Rank-160 pre-RoPE key factors and chunk landmarks on the GPU, values on the CPU, 256 chunks of 8 fetched per step.

codecs.name: SpeCache / PQCache
codecs.notes: A 1-bit copy (SpeCache) or 12-bit PQ codes (PQCache) on the GPU rank tokens; the exact fp16 pairs are fetched from host RAM, speculatively one step ahead.

codecs.name: KVTC
codecs.notes: A JPEG for KV: PCA basis shared across layers, water-filling bit allocation, DEFLATE. 18-22× for storage and transfer, never attended over directly.

codecs.name: TensorRT-LLM cold pages (NVFP4)
codecs.notes: NVFP4 applied as a KV page migrates to host or disk, decoded as it comes back. 3.5× against FP16, no transform, no Packer.

codecs.name: CacheGen
codecs.notes: Anchor-token deltas, layer-dependent bin sizes, arithmetic coding with per-(layer, channel) tables, CUDA decoder. The one KV codec with a real bitstream, because its channel is a network.

codecs.name: SnapKV / StreamingLLM / TriAttention
codecs.notes: Keep sinks and a window, or score once from an observation window, or use pre-RoPE key geometry. Then compact pages or the memory never comes back.

codecs.name: GQA / MLA / DeepSeek-V4
codecs.notes: Compression decided before pretraining. 576 elements per token per layer instead of 32,768; V4 caches one entry per 4 or per 128 tokens.

neural_enc.name: NEURON
neural_enc.real: Learned encoder network (conv / transformer analysis transform)

spatial.name: NEIGHBOR
spatial.real: Spatial (intra) prediction: PNG filters, intra modes

cm.name: MENTALIST
cm.real: Context modeling / context mixing (PPM, CM, PAQ-style)

neural_prior.name: ORACLE PRIME
neural_prior.real: Learned probability model (hyperprior, autoregressive / LM-based coding)

blockint.name: BLOCKY
blockint.real: Block-wise low-bit integer quantization (int8 / int4 + per-block scale)

chroma.name: ILLUSIONIST
chroma.real: Visual sensitivity model: chroma subsampling, CSF weighting

codebook.name: KEYMASTER
codebook.real: Trained VQ codebook (shipped to the decoder)

unrope.name: REWIND
unrope.real: Pre-RoPE key storage (undo the positional rotation before quantizing)

svd_lowrank.name: PROJECTOR
svd_lowrank.real: Rank-r SVD truncation of the key matrix (per-sequence, optionally shared across layers)

mla.name: BOTTLENECK
mla.real: Multi-head Latent Attention: a learned low-rank KV latent baked into the model

anchor_delta.name: ANCHORMAN
anchor_delta.real: Anchor-token delta coding (a group-of-pictures for KV)

coupled.name: SIAMESE
coupled.real: Coupled quantization: VQ over groups of 2-8 channels with loss-weighted centroids

waterline.name: WATERLINE
waterline.real: Adaptive bit allocation across transform coefficients (reverse water-filling)

fp4.name: QUARTER
fp4.real: NVFP4: 4-bit E2M1 floats with an FP8 scale per 16 values

escape.name: ESCAPE HATCH
escape.real: Dense-and-sparse decomposition: the top 1% outliers ride in a sparse fp16 side list

evict.name: REAPER
evict.real: Token eviction: keep or drop whole tokens by an importance score

sinkguard.name: BOUNCER
sinkguard.real: Importance exemptions: attention sinks and the newest tokens stay at full precision

spotlight.name: SPOTLIGHT
spotlight.real: Top-k attention selector: a cheap stand-in scores which tokens matter this step

basis.name: BLUEPRINT
basis.real: Trained transform basis shipped with the model (PCA matrices, learned rotations)

tiered.name: UNDERSTUDY
tiered.real: Two-tier cache: a lossy stand-in on the GPU, the lossless original in CPU DRAM, fetched on demand

onebit.name: THE ONE-BIT VAULT
onebit.codec: Coupled Quantization / CommVQ (calibrated vector quantization of KV)

coldkv.name: THE COLD STORAGE
coldkv.codec: KVTC (KV transform coding) / TensorRT-LLM cold-page NVFP4

bornsmall.name: THE ARCHITECT'S CUT
bornsmall.codec: GQA / MLA / DeepSeek-V4 CSA-HCA (compression baked into the model)
